build_task: build a PHyRE task template that places a ball into a jar with a staircase of bars in the way
create_staircase_bars: create five static bars arranged as a staircase with configurable y-span and angle
position_jar: position a static jar aligned left or right to a specific bar in the staircase
add_ball: add a dynamic ball at the top of the scene with configurable x position and scale
configure_task_relationships: configure the task to require the ball touching the jar with BALL solution tier
